payload.title: Trigger rubric optimization on every second human-label transition
payload.description: Default rubric trigger counts class-to-class changes in either direction. First transition does not fire; second does. Repeated labels and skips do not count. Derive state from durable feedback for restart safety and omit retracted votes. Trace count, threshold, previous/current labels and causal linkage. Keep other optimization and fitting schedules separate; update operational replay preflight ceilings. Verify fake-client operational replay and unit specs; preserve old recordings.
